scientific_integrity: Only primary research and standard matrix analytic facts are credited; original primary paper has linear-algebra MSC 15A60, whereas the present finite-operator-norm quotient study is classified 47A30. The 2021 article was available only by title and abstract. Finite numerical diagnostics are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are restricted to real equal-modulus signed cyclic shifts and complex Hermitian finite-matrix completions; general phases, weighted edges and other graph patterns are not classified. Independent scientific validation and publication-priority review remain outstanding.
title: Exact quotient operator norms and extremizers of signed cyclic shifts
